verdict.rationale: Temporal Cloud is a hosted service that stores customer workflow data, so a policy or control against AI-model training is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack contains no training opt-out, no data-use policy and no AI-training commitment. Payload Codec encryption and self-hosting are adjacent data-protection features, not a documented control over AI training, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
